summary: Shows looping over a dictionary with dict2items, accessing item.key and nested fields via item.value.<field>.
questions: How do I loop over a dictionary in Ansible?
How do I access nested values when looping over a dict?

answer_card.title: Looping over a dictionary
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ item.key }}: {{ item.value.ip_address }} {{ item.value.role }}"
  loop: "{{ server_configs | dict2items }}"
```

Each item has `item.key` and `item.value`; reach nested fields with `item.value.<field>`.
